incidents-bot: ALERT: billing_metering_delta exceeded threshold (3.5%) for aggregate token counts. Incident INC-2026-045. Correlation: aggregation pipeline. Paging oncall.
jen (oncall): Oncall Jen here, acknowledging. Starting triage.
priya (billing-engineer): Pulling per-tenant deltas for the last 6h. Running quick query...
priya (billing-engineer): ```sql
SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(shadow_tokens) as shadow
FROM usage_events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
omar (infra): Checking kafka consumer lag and redis. Running `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group billing-aggregator` now.
jen (oncall): I see a deployment at 2026-03-18T12:20Z to aggregator:v2.3.4 — matches start of drift.
priya (billing-engineer): We shipped a batching optimization in v2.3.4 that changed dedupe windows. Suspect double-counting on retried emit paths.
omar (infra): Consumer lag is normal, but aggregator instances show elevated ephemeral retries. Checking logs: `grep "emit retry" /var/log/aggregator/* | tail -n 50`.
jen (oncall): Proposal: toggle feature flag `billing.agg.batch_v2=false` to revert behavioral change, pause downstream alerts, and run a targeted backfill for 3h.
jen (oncall): Toggling flag now via ConsoleUI.
deploy-bot: Feature flag `billing.agg.batch_v2` set to false by jen (ui-toggle) — rollout=100%.
rafael (support): FYI: automated overage emails were sent between 12:29–12:33 UTC for ~12 tenants. I have the alert batch ids and can pause further notifications.
emily (product): Drafting customer note: "We're investigating an overcounting issue affecting some customers' usage reports; we've paused alerts and will reconcile any erroneous charges. ETA for reconciliation ~24h." DM me for wording.
priya (billing-engineer): Quick recon: tenant acme-corp shows tokens=1,240,000 vs shadow_tokens=1,050,000 -> ~18% divergence. Suspect retry amplification on high-concurrency clients.
omar (infra): I've restarted the affected aggregator pods to clear transient state and confirmed no new double-emits after flag flip.
jen (oncall): Started backfill job `backfill-175444` for window 12:00–15:00 UTC. Running in low-priority batch workers. ETA ~45m.
incidents-bot: Pager INC-2026-045 acknowledged by jen.
rafael (support): Paused billing-alert webhook (billing-alerts-pause=true) and suppressed scheduled emails. I'll prepare a list of impacted tenants for CS.
emily (product): Please hold on refunds until recon finishes; we should verify per-tenant deltas and create credits if overcharged.
priya (billing-engineer): After backfill completes we'll run a delta-emit reconciliation script and produce a CSV of adjustments. I own remediation + postmortem.
jen (oncall): Quick status: mitigation steps taken (flag revert, pod restart, alerts paused, backfill started). Next: complete backfill, verify counts, and schedule customer comms.
omar (infra): No signs of underlying infra degradation — root cause points to batching logic change in v2.3.4.
jen (oncall): Assigning postmortem to priya + jen. Tagging: #billing #oncall #incident-high. Anyone else to loop in?
emily (product): loop in CS lead and billing ops. I'll coordinate the customer message.
rafael (support): Copy.
jen (oncall): closing loop here — will update channel when backfill finishes or if status changes.
